name: curation/titanic-features-datafusion
description: Read the Titanic training split, recode sex and the title in the name, then let a notebook fill a missing age from its status group and size the family. Written for DataFusion (AW-3): it runs where AIWATCHER_QUERY_ENGINE=datafusion.

spec.steps:
df.select(
    col("row")["PassengerId"].alias("passenger_id"),
    col("row")["Name"].alias("name"),
    col("row")["Sex"].alias("sex"),
    col("row")["Age"].alias("age"),
    col("row")["Pclass"].alias("pclass"),
    col("row")["SibSp"].alias("sib_sp"),
    col("row")["Parch"].alias("parch"),
    col("row")["Fare"].alias("fare"),
    col("row")["Cabin"].alias("cabin"),
    col("row")["Survived"].alias("survived"),
)
.with_column("sex_code", f.when(col("sex") == lit("female"), lit(1)).otherwise(lit(0)))
.with_column("title", f.regexp_replace(col("name"), lit(r"^[^,]*,\s*([^.]+)\..*$"), lit(r"\1")))
.with_column(
    "status",
    f.when(col("title") == lit("Mr"), lit("mr"))
    .when(col("title") == lit("Master"), lit("master"))
    .when((col("title") == lit("Mrs")) | (col("title") == lit("Mme")), lit("mrs"))
    .when(
        (col("title") == lit("Miss")) | (col("title") == lit("Mlle")) | (col("title") == lit("Ms")),
        lit("miss"),
    )
    .otherwise(lit("rare")),
)
.with_column("outcome", f.when(col("survived") == lit(1), lit("survived")).otherwise(lit("died")))
.with_column(
    "deck",
    f.when(col("cabin").is_null(), lit("unknown"))
    .otherwise(f.regexp_replace(col("cabin"), lit("^(.).*$"), lit(r"\1"))),
)
.select(
    col("passenger_id"), col("name"), col("sex"), col("sex_code"), col("title"),
    col("status"), col("age"), col("pclass"), col("sib_sp"), col("parch"), col("fare"),
    col("deck"), col("survived"), col("outcome"),
)
